name: Kanjira
bio: Archetype: ST Debuff, Turn-Based. ⌽ Inflicts various debuffs based on present turn count. ⌽ Powerful skills when used on the right turns. ⌽ Semi-consistent (consistent at P1) 2 stacks of [Poison] to proc "Blasphemer of Night". ⌽ Synergy: Crit-oriented or [Poison] teammates (Jessica, Tuesday, Willow, etc.)
